objective: Define Creative Library, Story Bible and long-term Project Memory so creators can find, understand, relate, version, recover and reuse Creative Fragments and governed references without truth duplication or protected-information leakage.
design_findings: Creative Library, Story Bible and Project Memory are projections/organization rather than alternate truth stores.
Creator Projects/collections/tags/saved views do not change ownership visibility or truth.
Story Bible entries preserve evidence class between creative possibility, annotation and governed references.
Governed truth is referenced from owning-domain projections/versions rather than duplicated.
Project graph/backlinks/history derive from explicit stable relationships, references and incorporation receipts.
Visibility filtering occurs before counts/facets/rankings/similarity/graph topology/cardinality/timeline/AI.
Duplicate discovery is advisory and never silently merges identities or governed objects.
Open/unresolved/unused/dormant projections are attention candidates from the authorized graph.
Archive/rediscovery/import/export/recovery preserve stable IDs and provenance without authority transfer.
Core Library/Story Bible functionality remains useful without AI.
